args.body: Advance CATALOGUE-INVITED-AGENCY-PILOT independently of the existing catalogue operator decision. Reuse the completed merchant reply rehearsal and previously screened routes. Spend the remaining retrieval allowance only on an original current agency invitation with a concrete paid catalogue QA task. If it states a measurable acceptance rule, run the existing passing and failing controls adapted to that rule and preserve actual output. Prepare a scoped operator handoff if the invitation, submission eligibility and payment route support it. Close the bounded result after readback under valid ownership with a lesson. No external contact, spending or deployment.

description: Closed the original BOAMP keyword screen after reading back all 12 records. They were published in 2017–2024, and every recorded response deadline had passed. The separate date-first capture returned 12 notices dated 23 November with no link-QA scope pointers. Those results limit follow-up on the sampled notices. A live original notice with separately quotable link QA and a measurable acceptance criterion would reopen that route. Treasury has CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Five unclassified feedback sources and an unavailable order register leave demand and order status unknown. The next commercial action is to check the existing catalogue offer for an actionable buyer or operator event and advance it through the authorized workflow if evidenced.
